en: In the *Āryatriskandhasūtra*, this is the confession of transgressions: "I, who am named so-and-so, go for refuge to the Buddha."
I go for refuge to the Dharma;
I go for refuge to the Saṅgha. Homage to the Blessed One!
Homage to Śākyamuni, the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the Perfectly Awakened One;
homage to the one who crushes with the essence of the vajra.
Homage to Ratnārcis!
Homage to Nāgeśvararāja! Homage to Vīrasena!
Homage to Vīranandin!
Homage to Ratnāgni!
Homage to Ratnacandraprabha!
Homage to Amoghadarśin!
Homage to Ratnacandra!
Homage to Nirmala!
Homage to Śūradatta!
Homage to Brahmā!
Homage to Brahmadatta!
Homage to Varuṇa!
Homage to the deity Varuṇa!
Homage to Bhadraśrī!
Homage to Candanaśrī!
Homage to Anantaujas! Homage to Prabhāsaśrī!
Homage to Aśokaśrī!
Homage to Nārāyaṇa! Homage to Kusumaśrī!
Homage to the Tathāgata Brahmajyotirvikrīḍitābhijña. Homage to the Tathāgata Padmajyotirvikrīḍitābhijña.
Homage to Ghanashri.
Homage to Smṛtiśrī! Homage to Suparikīrtitanāmadheyaśrī! Homage to Indraketudhvajarāja!
Homage to Suvikrāntaśrī! Homage to Suvijitasaṃgrāma!
Homage to Vikrāntagāmin!
Homage to Samantāvabhāsavyūhaśrī. Homage to Ratnapadmavikrāmin.
Homage to the Tathāgata, Arhat, Samyaksaṃbuddha Ratnapadmasupratiṣṭhitaśailendrarāja.

May all those Tathāgatas, Arhats, and Samyaksaṃbuddhas, headed by these, who currently reside, remain, and maintain themselves in all the world-systems throughout the ten directions—may those Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, attend to me!

Whatever evil karma I may have committed, caused to be committed, or rejoiced in being committed, while wandering through this present life, other lives, or the beginningless cycle of births and deaths; [may they attend to it].
Whether property belonging to a stūpa or belonging to the Saṅgha has been stolen,
or was caused to be stolen, or is being stolen, and one has rejoiced in it;
or whether the five deeds of immediate retribution have been committed, or caused to be committed, or are being committed, and one has rejoiced in them.

If I have engaged in the ten unwholesome paths of action, or have incited others to engage in them, or have rejoiced in their engagement; by whatever karmic obstruction I am veiled such that I might go to hell, or to the animal realm, or to the domain of Yama, or to the borderlands— [may it be purified].

Whether I should be reborn among the mlecchas, or be born among the long-lived gods, or incur a deficiency of the sense faculties, or embrace false views, or fail to encounter the appearance of a Buddha—
all that karmic obscuration I confess in the presence of those Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, who are wisdom itself, who are vision itself, who are witnesses, who are the authority, and who know and see.
I confess it and do not conceal it; I undertake restraint for the future.

May those Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, attend to me: whatever gift may have been given by me while wandering through this birth, or other births, or throughout the beginningless cycle of rebirths—even down to a mere morsel of food given to one born in the animal realm—[I confess it all].
Whatever morality may have been observed by me, whatever root of merit from my dwelling in the holy life,
whatever root of merit from my ripening of sentient beings, and whatever root of merit from my thought of awakening—

And whatever roots of merit for unsurpassed knowledge I possess, having gathered them all together into a single mass, weighed them, and condensed them, I dedicate them toward unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment through a progressively superior dedication (the most venerable of the venerable).

Just as it was dedicated by the past Buddhas, the Blessed Ones; just as the future Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, will dedicate; and just as the present Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, in the ten directions, are now dedicating—so do I likewise dedicate.
I confess all evil.
I rejoice in all merit;
I entreat all Buddhas:
may there be for me unsurpassed wisdom.
To those Victors, the supreme among men— those who have passed away, those yet to come, and those who currently abide—
I go for refuge with palms joined, [seeking] all those whose praises are infinite and who are like oceans of virtue.
// Completed //
(The Noble Mahāyāna Sūtra of the Three Sections is completed.)
